description: Drinking Water Mapping Application to Protect Source Waters (DWMAPS) is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. This user-friendly tool can help communities and individuals find answers to questions like: DWMAPS can provide drinking water professionals, source water collaboratives, watershed groups, and others with information to update source water assessments and prioritize source water protection measures in any location or watershed in the country. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
